calculation.formation_v2: single-phase equilibrium at the phase's low-T composition, 298.15 K; dfS = S - sum x_i S_i(SER); SER entropies from unary equilibria at 298.15 K

mixing_table.partials: H_i - H_i(pure liquid) from central differences of the integral HM_MIX (h = 1e-4)
mixing_table.reference: pure liquid A and B at T

sentences.text: This synthetic document describes the Cu–Mg binary system as calculated with pycalphad from the SGTE dataset CuMg-16Hal.tdb; every figure, table and stated value is generated, and the exact values are kept in a separate truth key.
The highest invariant reaction, L → (Cu) + Cu2Mg, lies at 725.2 °C.
The Cu–Mg system belongs to the 20 binaries of the ORCHID benchmark, chosen to cover diagram types such as congruent compound, intermetallic rich.
The thermodynamic description is the SGTE collection entry [1], which reproduces the assessment of B. Hallstedt, unpublished, 2016. [2].
The calculations use pycalphad 0.11.2 at 1 atm.
Pure Cu melts at 1084.6 °C.
Pure Mg melts at 649.9 °C.
Eutectic equilibrium L → (Cu) + Cu2Mg is found at 725.2 °C and 20.9 at.% Mg (L).
We obtain 552.0 °C for the eutectic reaction (L → Cu2Mg + CuMg2), where L has 59.5 at.% Mg.
Eutectic equilibrium L → CuMg2 + (Mg) is found at 484.9 °C and 83.7 at.% (L).
Cu2Mg melts congruently at 795.8 °C and 33.0 at.% Mg.
CuMg2 melts congruently at 567.9 °C and 66.5 at.% Mg.
Table 1 compares the calculated temperatures with experimental values from the literature [3–5]; in this synthetic document those values and references are fictitious.
The upper stability limit of Cu2Mg is 795.8 °C.
The solubility of Mg in (Cu) reaches 7.0 at.% at 725.2 °C.
At 1450 K the integral mixing enthalpy of the liquid has its minimum, −9350 J/mol, at 44.0 at.% Mg.
The calculated enthalpy of formation of CuMg2 at 298.15 K is −8.65 kJ/mol per mole of atoms.
Per formula unit CuMg2 this is −25.9 kJ/mol.
Its heat capacity at room temperature is 24.59 J/(mol K).
For the equiatomic liquid at 1450 K, the Gibbs energy of mixing is −15.88 kJ/mol-atom.
This document is synthetic and exists only to test extraction tools; its truth key lists every boundary, field, invariant, plotted point, table cell and stated value.
